# Gaurav Sharma

> Portfolio of Gaurav Sharma, an Associate Product Manager at Paytm working on agentic AI products, with previous product experience at Times Internet.

This site presents Gaurav's product experience, selected product-management case studies, software projects, resume, and contact information. The case studies describe his work and outcomes; project pages describe personal and portfolio software projects.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://gauravsharma.cc/): Product experience, selected case studies, and featured projects.
- [About](https://gauravsharma.cc/about): Background, product experience, and working approach.
- [Resume](https://gauravsharma.cc/resume): Resume and experience overview.
- [Contact](https://gauravsharma.cc/contact): Contact form and email.

## Case studies

- [TOI App Games Funnel Optimization](https://gauravsharma.cc/case-studies/toi-app-games-funnel-optimization): Improving discovery and entry into the Times of India App games experience.
- [Consumer App Retention Through Interactive Content](https://gauravsharma.cc/case-studies/consumer-app-retention): Retention work using interactive content, funnel design, UX improvements, and analytics.
- [TOI App Homepage Redesign](https://gauravsharma.cc/case-studies/toi-app-homepage-redesign): Homepage hierarchy, personalisation, and content discovery.
- [News Personalization Product Operations](https://gauravsharma.cc/case-studies/news-personalization-product-operations): Operationalising news personalisation across product, ML, engineering, design, and editorial teams.
- [ET Markets Integration in the TOI App](https://gauravsharma.cc/case-studies/et-markets-toi-app-integration): Integrating a specialist markets experience into a consumer news app.
- [All case studies](https://gauravsharma.cc/case-studies)
